newsitem.title: USA: Chicago transit agency sets $25 mln cuts - papers.
newsitem.headline: Chicago transit agency sets $25 mln cuts - papers.

text.p: Chicago Transit Authority approved a plan to cut late night train and bus service and eliminate some bus routes to save nearly $25 million per year, Chicago newspapers reported Thursday.
CTA board members adopted the plan Wednesday to make $37 million of cuts that they say will affect about 3 percent of riders.
Ten bus routes will be eliminated in October and five others after alternate routes are developed under the authority's plan. Late night train service cuts will begin in March.
Even with the cuts, the transit authority projects continuing deficits without further cuts or federal funding.
